description: Quantifying the Pex9 route: how diagnostic is a hydrophobic residue preceding the PTS1 tripeptide, given AMD2 has Phe at position -4
code:
import requests, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

# Competing consideration: Pex9 is a second, condition-specific PTS1 receptor.
# Yifrach 2023 (PMID 36279206) reports its cargo choice is largely set by the
# HYDROPHOBIC residue preceding the PTS1 tripeptide. AMD2 ends ...ASWLF|SKI,
# so position -4 is Phe. That is the single most plausible route by which
# AMD2's -SKI could be a genuine signal. Test how distinctive that feature is.

def fasta_parse(txt):
    out={}; k=None; b=[]
    for ln in txt.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith(">"):
            if k: out[k]="".join(b)
            k=ln[1:]; b=[]
        else: b.append(ln.strip())
    if k: out[k]="".join(b)
    return out

KD = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,
      'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,
      'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
HYDROPHOBIC = set("AVLIMFWC")
PERM = re.compile(r"[SAPCTNKQGV][KRHNQSM][LMIVFYA]$")

r = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
    params={"query":"organism_id:559292 AND reviewed:true","format":"fasta"}, timeout=300)
r.raise_for_status()
prot = fasta_parse(r.text)
rows=[]
for h,s in prot.items():
    acc = h.split("|")[1]
    g = re.search(r"GN=(\S+)", h)
    if len(s) < 15: continue
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc, gene=g.group(1) if g else "", length=len(s),
                     cterm3=s[-3:], m4=s[-4], dodec=s[-12:]))
P = pd.DataFrame(rows)
P["perm_pts1"] = P.cterm3.str.match(PERM).fillna(False)
P["m4_hydrophobic"] = P.m4.isin(HYDROPHOBIC)
print("reviewed yeast proteins:", len(P))

amd2 = P[P.gene=="AMD2"].iloc[0]
print("\nAMD2:", amd2.acc, "len", amd2.length, "| dodecamer", amd2.dodec,
      "| tripeptide", amd2.cterm3, "| -4 residue", amd2.m4)

PEX9_CARGO = ["MLS1","MLS2"]
PEX5_CARGO = ["CTA1","FOX2","POT1","MDH3","PCS60","GTO1","LYS1","PXP1","PXP2",
              "TES1","IDP3","CAT2","SPS19","NPY1","DCI1","ECI1","AAT2","STR3"]
bona = P[P.gene.isin(PEX9_CARGO+PEX5_CARGO)].copy()
bona["receptor"] = np.where(bona.gene.isin(PEX9_CARGO), "Pex9 cargo", "Pex5 cargo")
print("\nCharacterised yeast PTS1 matrix proteins, C-terminal context:")
print(bona[["gene","acc","dodec","cterm3","m4","m4_hydrophobic","receptor"]]
      .sort_values(["receptor","m4_hydrophobic"]).to_string(index=False))

perm = P[P.perm_pts1]
frac_all, frac_perm = P.m4_hydrophobic.mean(), perm.m4_hydrophobic.mean()
frac_bona = bona.m4_hydrophobic.mean()
print(f"\nFraction with a hydrophobic residue at position -4:")
print(f"  all reviewed yeast proteins    : {frac_all:.3f}  (n={len(P)})")
print(f"  permissive-PTS1 proteins       : {frac_perm:.3f}  (n={len(perm)})")
print(f"  characterised PTS1 cargos      : {frac_bona:.3f}  (n={len(bona)})")

sub = perm[perm.m4_hydrophobic]
n_both = len(sub)
n_known = int(sub.gene.isin(PEX9_CARGO+PEX5_CARGO).sum())
print(f"\nYeast proteins with BOTH a permissive PTS1 and hydrophobic -4: {n_both}")
print(f"  of those, known peroxisomal matrix proteins: {n_known}")
print(f"  => positive predictive value = {n_known/max(n_both,1):.3f}")
sub[["acc","gene","dodec","cterm3","m4"]].to_csv("perm_pts1_hydrophobic_minus4.csv", index=False)

known = perm.gene.isin(PEX9_CARGO+PEX5_CARGO)
tab = [[int((perm.m4_hydrophobic & known).sum()),  int((~perm.m4_hydrophobic & known).sum())],
       [int((perm.m4_hydrophobic & ~known).sum()), int((~perm.m4_hydrophobic & ~known).sum())]]
odds,p = fisher_exact(tab)
print("\n2x2 [hydrophobic -4 x known peroxisomal] within the permissive-PTS1 set:", tab)
print(f"Fisher exact: OR={odds:.2f}, p={p:.3g}")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4.8))
ax = axes[0]
cats = ["All reviewed\nproteins","Permissive\nPTS1","Characterised\nPTS1 cargos","AMD2"]
vals = [frac_all, frac_perm, frac_bona, 1.0]
ax.bar(cats, vals, color=["#9aa0a6","#9aa0a6","#2e7d32","#c62828"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i, v+0.02, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel("fraction hydrophobic at position -4"); ax.set_ylim(0,1.15)
ax.set_title("A hydrophobic residue before the PTS1 tripeptide\nis common in the proteome and not diagnostic", fontsize=11)

ax = axes[1]
order = bona.sort_values(["receptor","m4"])
ax.barh(range(len(order)), [KD[m] for m in order.m4],
        color=["#1565c0" if r=="Pex9 cargo" else "#2e7d32" for r in order.receptor])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{g}  ...{d[-4:]}" for g,d in zip(order.gene, order.dodec)], fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(KD[amd2.m4], color="#c62828", ls="--", lw=2,
           label=f"AMD2 position -4 = {amd2.m4} (KD {KD[amd2.m4]:+.1f})")
ax.axvline(0, color="k", lw=0.6)
ax.set_xlabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy at position -4")
ax.set_title("Position -4 in characterised yeast PTS1 cargos\nblue = Pex9 cargo, green = Pex5 cargo", fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
